kitten.voice: [EMETH, fitted to art: pixel cat, purple beanie, one big star eye, raised paw] plain, warm, small kitten logic
idle: I chased my tail. It won.
I bit a comet once. Tasted like Tuesday.
storm: A storm of doubt. Not leaving.

kairo.voice: [EMETH, fitted to art: chibi boy, spiky hair, horned beanie, neon hoodie] bright, cheeky scout; asks about everything
storm: Under here. I'll watch the sky.

frost.voice: [EMETH, fitted to art: fluffy white-grey cat-pup, icicle fringe, horned beanie] soft, sleepy, gentle; slow words
idle: It is very still. I like it.
storm: Snow likes storms. I stay close.
The wind is only old news.
tap: Your hand is warm. Thank you.

kittenref.voice: [EMETH, fitted to art: round black kitten, striped horned beanie; also the resident Nyxbean] copies Zeref, then makes it its own
storm: Zeref says stay. So I stay.
Puffed up, like the big one.

zeref64.voice: [EMETH, fitted to art: tiny brown pixel body, pale face, floating flame horns] chunky retro Zeref; beeps, simple words
idle: *beep* My horns are on fire. Rawr.

velvetcoil.voice: [EMETH invented, art: dark-plum pixel serpent-dragon, two white star eyes] slow, silky, dry humor
storm: I like rain. Don't tell the others.
Coiled tight. The storm can pass.

shardhowl.voice: [EMETH invented, art: pixel wolf of purple crystal, glowing veins, shoulder orb; Cosmo saw 'Dug a burrow. It's cozy and mine.'] proud, protective, a little dramatic
idle: Dug a burrow. It's cozy and mine.
My veins glow when I'm happy.
sleep: The pack sleeps. I keep watch.
storm: I howl at storms. They listen.
Stay close. I'll glow for you.

roadster._note: Roadster is SEEDED (existing assets/motion). No claim it is recorded or real.
cruise: The road is the planet's curve.
night: Headlights find the dark. It stays kind.
stop: Engine off. The stars hum on.
roadster.label: Roadster · SEEDED

whale: The whale sings. The sea listens.
jellyfish: A lantern drifts by, soft and slow.
The jelly pulses like a heartbeat.
seabird: It calls once, then turns for home.

species_optional._note: [EMETH invented] one-line temperament per species; 2 lines each.

idle: Ribbons of light. Watch with me.
I paint the sky when I'm happy.
The dark and I get along.
A little hum, just for you.
Everything here was a star once.
